description: WebSocket protocol source of truth for the drone backend. Values must match WsMessageNames. The DJI device channel (/ws/drone) was retired with ADR-0014: devices no longer hold a server long connection, and the server no longer issues start/stop-live commands.

/ws/web.description: Supervision/shipper web client. Supervisors (role 2) receive all orders' FLIGHT_TELEMETRY; ?orderId= restricts to one order (owner or supervisor, otherwise closed with 1008).
